title: Export from each tab holds only that tab's parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A and part B, and one inactive part, part C.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all three.
  • Use a computer that can open the exported file in a spreadsheet program.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Click Export.
  4. Open the downloaded file.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box again.
  7. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  8. Click Export.
  9. Open the second downloaded file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export.

Step 3:

  • A file downloads.

Step 4:

  • The file holds exactly two parts, part A and part B, the parts the search lists on the Active tab.
  • Part C is not in the file.

Step 5:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 6:

  • Part C is listed.

Step 7:

  • The menu lists Cycle count, Activate parts and Export.

Step 8:

  • A second file downloads.

Step 9:

  • The second file holds exactly one part, part C.
  • Parts A and B are not in it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S1-R9: “Export in the actions menu exports the parts on the tab that shows: active parts from the Active tab, inactive parts from the Inactive tab.”
  • S1-R9b: “The export includes every part on that tab that matches the current search, filters and Supply filter, including parts not yet scrolled into view. With nothing matching, the message "Empty export" shows and no file is made.”
